<HEAD>
<TITLE>exv99w1</TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY bgcolor="#FFFFFF">
<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">


<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;99.1</B>
</DIV>

<P><DIV style="position: relative; float: left; width: 8%">

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><IMG src="u10774u1077400.gif" alt="(RIO TINTO LOGO)">
</DIV>

</DIV>
<DIV style="position: relative; float: right; width: 90%">


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 9pt; margin-top: 11pt">Rio Tinto plc<BR>
2 Eastbourne Terrace<BR>
London W2 6LG<BR>
United Kingdom<BR>
T &#043;44 (0)&nbsp;20 7781 2000<BR>
F &#043;44 (0)&nbsp;20 7781 1800

</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 18pt; color: red; margin-top: 50pt">Press release
</DIV>

<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><DIV style="width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; FONT-size: 1px">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Rio Tinto approves US$933&nbsp;million extension of Marandoo iron ore mine life in
Western Australia&#146;s Pilbara region</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>8 February&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto has approved a US$933&nbsp;million investment (Rio Tinto share 100%) to extend the
life of the Marandoo iron ore mine by 16&nbsp;years to 2030.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto chief executive Iron Ore and Australia, Sam Walsh said the Marandoo extension
plays an important role in sustaining the Pilbara operations&#146; annual capacity rate,
complementing the major expansion programmes now underway.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Located 35km north east of the town of Tom Price, the project will extend the Marandoo
mine life at its current mining rate of 15&nbsp;million tonnes a year by developing the
adjacent reserves below the water table.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Sam Walsh
said, &#147;With a high iron and low phosphorus content,
Marandoo&#146;s Marra Mamba ore
assists in maintaining the Pilbara Blend grade requirements and maximising the value of
our integrated Pilbara operations.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&#147;It also underlines our ability to develop projects to sustain tonnage at the same
time as expanding our overall production capability.&#148;
</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">One component of the Marandoo project is a water management strategy to manage the
operation&#146;s dewatering, including priority water delivery to the Tom Price township and
mine operations, the reinjection of water into the Southern Fortescue borefield to the
north and a proposed irrigated agriculture scheme.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The project includes the construction of a wet processing plant and on-site facilities,
an accommodation village and construction camp and additional mining fleet.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The project requires a number of Government and regulatory approvals, all of which have
been received or are progressing well and on schedule.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>About Rio Tinto</B>
</DIV>

</DIV>
<DIV style="position: relative; float: right; width: 90%">
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto is a leading international mining group headquartered in the UK, combining
Rio Tinto plc, a London and NYSE listed company, and Rio Tinto Limited, which is listed
on the Australian Securities Exchange.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto&#146;s business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Major products
are aluminium, copper, diamonds, energy (coal and uranium), gold, industrial minerals
(borax, titanium dioxide, salt, talc) and iron ore. Activities span the world but are
strongly represented in Australia and North America with significant businesses in South
America, Asia, Europe and southern Africa.
</DIV>

</DIV>
<BR clear="all"><BR>


<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;99.2</B>
</DIV>

<P><DIV style="position: relative; float: left; width: 8%">
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><IMG src="u10774u1077400.gif" alt="(RIO TINTO LOGO)">
</DIV>

</DIV>
<DIV style="position: relative; float: right; width: 90%">

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 9pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto plc<BR>
2 Eastbourne Terrace<BR>
London W2 6LG<BR>
United Kingdom<BR>
T &#043;44 (0)&nbsp;20 7781 2000<BR>
F &#043;44 (0)&nbsp;20 7781 1800
</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 18pt; color: red; margin-top: 50pt">Press release
</DIV>

<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><DIV style="width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; FONT-size: 1px">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Rio Tinto to invest US$277&nbsp;million in expansion of concentrate production capacity
at Iron Ore Company of Canada</B></DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>8 February&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto has given the go-ahead to a further US$277&nbsp;million investment (Rio Tinto share
US$163&nbsp;million) in the next phase of a project that will ultimately raise the Iron Ore
Company of Canada&#146;s (IOC)&nbsp;concentrate production capacity by 40 per cent to 26&nbsp;million
tonnes per year (Mt/a).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">This is the second phase of a three stage expansion that was announced in May&nbsp;2010 with
a US$400&nbsp;million investment (Rio Tinto share US$235&nbsp;million) to raise production
capacity from 18 Mt/a to 22 Mt/a.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Phase two
of the project will increase IOC&#146;s spiral and magnetite concentrate production
capacity by an average of 1.3 Mt/a to 23.3 Mt/a from 2013.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Recent studies have highlighted an opportunity to improve time to market through bringing
forward some capital items from the third stage, resulting in higher level of production
earlier. The third stage of the planned expansion to 26 Mt/a is currently under study and
a final investment decision is expected by 2012.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto chief executive, Iron ore and Australia, Sam Walsh said the project was an
important development in increasing IOC&#146;s production at a time when global demand is
escalating.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&#147;Global seaborne iron ore demand is projected to increase substantially over the next
decade, and IOC&#146;s concentrate is well placed to complement the increasing use of
lower-quality ore to meet that demand,&#148; he said.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">&#147;With
high iron content and very low levels of impurities, IOC&#146;s concentrate provides
significant value to steel producers as ore grades from direct shipping mines continue to
decline.&#148;
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The
project&#146;s construction is set to start immediately to capitalise on the brief
Labrador summer construction season and will be fully commissioned by the end of 2012.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>About Rio Tinto</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto is a leading international mining group headquartered in the UK, combining
Rio Tinto plc, a London and NYSE listed company, and Rio Tinto Limited, which is listed
on the Australian Securities Exchange.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto&#146;s business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Major products
are aluminium, copper, diamonds, energy (coal and uranium), gold, industrial minerals
(borax, titanium dioxide, salt, talc) and iron ore. Activities span the world but are
strongly represented in Australia and North America with significant businesses in South
America, Asia, Europe and southern Africa.
</DIV>

</DIV>
<BR clear="all"><BR>

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 18pt; color: red;  margin-top: 50pt">Press release
</DIV>

<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><DIV style="width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; FONT-size: 1px">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Rio Tinto&#146;s bid for Riversdale extended by 14&nbsp;days to 4 March&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>Institutional Acceptance Facility established</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>10 February&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto Jersey Holdings 2010 Limited (RTJ)&nbsp;has extended the offer period for its
takeover bid for all of the shares in Riversdale Mining Limited (Riversdale) by a period
of 14&nbsp;days. The offer is now due to close at 7.00pm (Sydney, Australia time) on 4 March
2011 (unless further extended or withdrawn).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Attached, in relation to this extension, are copies of the following documents:
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="2%" nowrap align="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>a notice under section 650D of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) (Corporations Act) of the
variation of the offer for this extension;</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="2%" nowrap align="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>a notice under section 630(2) of the Corporations Act, which confirms that 24 February
2011 is the new date for giving notice as to the status of the conditions of the offer; and</TD>
</TR>

<TR>
    <TD style="font-size: 6pt">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR><TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="3%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="2%" nowrap align="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>a letter to Riversdale shareholders in relation to the extension of the offer period.</TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>
<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">RTJ&#146;s offer for Riversdale remains subject to a number of conditions (which are set out in
the Bidder&#146;s Statement dated 10 January&nbsp;2011)<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">1</SUP>, including a greater than 50%
minimum acceptance condition (MAC).
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Institutional Acceptance Facility</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">RTJ has also today established an institutional acceptance facility (IAF), to be
operated by Computershare Investor Services.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The IAF allows eligible institutional Riversdale shareholders that do not wish to accept
the offer until it has become unconditional to indicate their intention to accept prior to
the offer becoming unconditional. To ensure RTJ is able to fulfil the MAC, put itself in a
position to declare its bid unconditional and therefore pay the cash consideration
available under the offer, we encourage you to accept the offer or provide your acceptance
instructions into the IAF as soon as possible.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">In accordance with section 647(3)(b) of the Corporations Act, attached is a copy of the
first supplementary bidder&#146;s statement in relation to the offer, which sets out further
information relating to the IAF.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The offer has been unanimously recommended by the Board of Riversdale in the absence of a
superior proposal. Riversdale shareholders should ensure they read the Target&#146;s Statement
dated 24 January&nbsp;2011, which outlines the reasons for the Riversdale Directors&#146;
recommendation. RTJ also notes that on 6 December&nbsp;2010, Riversdale announced that it was
in discussions with Rio Tinto about a possible corporate transaction. It has now been in
excess of two months since the market was made aware of a possible change of control
transaction regarding Riversdale and in that time no other
</DIV>



<DIV align="left">
<DIV style="font-size: 3pt; margin-top: 16pt; width: 18%; border-top: 1px solid #000000">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>

<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

    <TD width="3%"></TD>

    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>On 21 January&nbsp;2011, RTJ announced to ASX that the condition to its offer
relating to FIRB approval had been satisfied on that same day.</TD>
</TR>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>About Rio Tinto</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto is a leading international mining group headquartered in the UK, combining
Rio Tinto plc, a London and NYSE listed company, and Rio Tinto Limited, which is listed
on the Australian Securities Exchange.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto&#146;s business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Major products
are aluminium, copper, diamonds, energy (coal and uranium), gold, industrial minerals
(borax, titanium dioxide, salt, talc) and iron ore. Activities span the world but are
strongly represented in Australia and North America with significant businesses in South
America, Asia, Europe and southern Africa.

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 18pt; color: red; margin-top: 50pt">Press release
</DIV>

<DIV align="Center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><DIV style="width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; FONT-size: 1px">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Rio Tinto&#146;s bid for Riversdale &#151; Australian Securities and
Investments Commission relief</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>17 February&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto Jersey Holdings 2010 Limited (RTJ)&nbsp;today issued a Second Supplementary
Bidder&#146;s Statement in relation to its current takeover bid for ordinary shares in
Riversdale Mining Limited.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The Second Supplementary Bidder&#146;s Statement contains information about
Australian Securities and Investments Commission decisions notified to RTJ, in
response to RTJ&#146;s applications for relief from certain provisions of the
Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) as they apply to the takeover bid.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The Second Supplementary Bidder&#146;s Statement was today submitted to the
Australian Securities Exchange. A copy is available at
<U>www.riotinto.com</U>.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>About Rio Tinto</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto is a leading international mining group headquartered in the UK,
combining Rio Tinto plc, a London and NYSE listed company, and Rio Tinto
Limited, which is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto&#146;s business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Major
products are aluminium, copper, diamonds, energy (coal and uranium), gold,
industrial minerals (borax, titanium dioxide, salt, talc) and iron ore.
Activities span the world but are strongly represented in Australia and North
America with significant businesses in South America, Asia, Europe and southern
Africa.
</DIV>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">


<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B>Exhibit&nbsp;99.5</B>
</DIV>

<P><DIV style="position: relative; float: left; width: 8%">

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><IMG src="u10774u1077400.gif" alt="(RIO TINTO LOGO)">
</DIV>

</DIV>
<DIV style="position: relative; float: right; width: 90%">

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 9pt; margin-top: 6pt">120 Collins Street<BR>
Melbourne 3000<BR>
Australia<BR>
T &#043;61 (0)&nbsp;3 9283 3333<BR>
F &#043;61 (0)&nbsp;3 9283 3707

</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 18pt; color: red; margin-top: 50pt">Press release
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><DIV style="width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; FONT-size: 1px">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>Rio Tinto receives US$340&nbsp;million binding offer for talc business</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>23 February&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto has received a binding offer from Imerys to acquire its talc business
for an enterprise value of US$340&nbsp;million. A period of exclusivity with Imerys
has been agreed, and Rio Tinto will respond to this binding offer following
consultation with the relevant European works councils.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Guy Elliott, chief financial officer, Rio Tinto said, &#147;The successful sale of
our global talc business would deliver good value to our shareholders and
remains aligned with our strategic focus on large scale assets. As a leading
supplier of industrial minerals, Imerys is well positioned to enable the ongoing
success of the talc business.&#148;
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The talc business has about 1,000 employees at 24 locations in Europe, North
America, Australia and Asia.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Completion of the contemplated transaction is subject to customary closing
conditions, including applicable regulatory approvals.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Since 2008, Rio Tinto has completed more than 18 divestments in excess of
US$11&nbsp;billion.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>About Rio Tinto</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto is a leading international mining group headquartered in the UK,
combining Rio Tinto plc, a London and NYSE listed company, and Rio Tinto
Limited, which is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto&#146;s business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Major
products are aluminium, copper, diamonds, energy (coal and uranium), gold,
industrial minerals (borax, titanium dioxide, salt, talc) and iron ore.
Activities span the world but are strongly represented in Australia and North
America with significant businesses in South America, Asia, Europe and southern
Africa.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>About Imerys</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The world leader in adding value to minerals, Imerys is active in 47
countries through more than 240 industrial and commercial sites. The Group
achieved more than &#128;3.3&nbsp;billion in sales in 2010. Imerys develops
solutions that improve its customers&#146; product performance and manufacturing
efficiency, thanks to minerals it mines and processes from reserves with rare
qualities. The Group&#146;s products have a great many applications in everyday life,
including construction, personal care, paper, paint, plastic, ceramics,
telecommunications and beverage filtration. More comprehensive information about
Imerys may be obtained from its website (<U>www.Imerys.com</U>).
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 6pt">Registered
in Australia Rio Tinto Limited 120 Collins Street Melbourne 3000
Australia ABN 96 004 458 404</DIV>

</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 18pt; color: red; margin-top: 50pt">Press release
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><DIV style="width: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #000000; FONT-size: 1px">&nbsp;</DIV>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>Rio Tinto&#146;s bid for Riversdale extended by 14&nbsp;days to 18 March&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>24 February&nbsp;2011</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto Jersey Holdings 2010 Limited (RTJ)&nbsp;has extended the offer period for
its takeover bid for all of the shares in Riversdale Mining Limited (Riversdale)
by a period of 14&nbsp;days. The offer is now due to close at 7.00pm (Sydney,
Australia time) on 18 March&nbsp;2011 (unless further extended or withdrawn).
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The following documents in relation to the extension were submitted to the
Australian Securities Exchange:
</DIV>


<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="1%" nowrap align="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>a notice under section 650D of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) (Corporations Act) of
the variation of the offer for this extension;</TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="1%" nowrap align="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>a notice under section 630(2) of the Corporations Act, which confirms that 10 March
2011 is the new date for giving notice as to the status of the conditions of the offer;
and</TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 6pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">

<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="1%" nowrap align="left"><B>&#149;</B></TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>a letter to Riversdale shareholders in relation to the extension of the offer period.</TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">RTJ&#146;s offer for Riversdale remains subject to a number of conditions (which are
set out in the Bidder&#146;s Statement dated 10 January&nbsp;2011)<SUP style="FONT-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">1</SUP>, including a
greater than 50 per cent minimum acceptance condition (MAC).
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The offer has been unanimously recommended by the Board of Riversdale in the
absence of a superior proposal. Riversdale shareholders should ensure they read the
Target&#146;s Statement dated 24 January&nbsp;2011, which outlines the reasons for the
Riversdale Directors&#146; recommendation.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">RTJ encourages Riversdale shareholders to accept its attractive $16 cash offer now.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Copies of the documents submitted to the Australian Securities Exchange are
available at <U>www.riotinto.com</U>.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt"><B>About Rio Tinto</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto is a leading international mining group headquartered in the UK,
combining Rio Tinto plc, a London and NYSE listed company, and Rio Tinto
Limited, which is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.
</DIV>


<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">Rio Tinto&#146;s business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Major
products are aluminium, copper, diamonds, energy (coal and uranium), gold,
industrial minerals (borax, titanium dioxide, salt, talc) and iron ore.
Activities span the world but are strongly represented in Australia and North
America with significant businesses in South America, Asia, Europe and southern
Africa.
</DIV>


<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><B><I>Cont.../</I></B>
</DIV>

its offer relating to FIRB approval had been satisfied on that same day.</TD>
</TR>
